source.title: Superior Court Motion, Affidavit and Instructions to Expunge or Seal Record - Felony

legalTreatment.treatment: Superior-55 Part Two is the single-felony first-offender route; the participant truthfully completes only statements that are true and executes before an authorized notary or clerk.
legalTreatment.sourceWordingPreserved: The official fourth Part Two statement continues to say single MISDEMEANOR; the packet does not rewrite or preselect it.
